profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Walmart Global Tech
profile.summary: I'm a software engineer with expertise in backend infrastructure, data engineering, and search ranking. I design and optimize large-scale data pipelines, low-latency services, and ML-powered ranking systems that impact millions of users. Outside of work, I enjoy building infra-heavy projects like distributed key-value store, sharpening my skills in distributed systems, fault tolerance, consensus, and system design.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and delivered full-stack enterprise applications (Java, Python, Node.js, React, AWS) serving hundreds of thousands of users, with a focus on scalable microservices and event-driven systems.

• Passwordless Authentication → Led the development of the core authentication microservice (Node.js, Redis, DynamoDB), enabling a 200% increase in mobile app downloads within the first month; implemented secure audit trail for compliance.

• Broadcast Automation System → Built and deployed a Kafka and AWS-based messaging platform broadcasting to 400k+ clients weekly via email/SMS; developed ETL pipelines with PySpark, Glue, and EMR to process user events for analytics.

• Chatbot Assistance Platform → Enhanced a Watson/Live-Person powered chatbot for 20k+ users, implementing seamless session persistence and backend optimizations that reduced response latency.

• Event Connect Platform → Architected a Python/MongoDB backend service for event management, supporting 10k+ active registrations in the first quarter.
